conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸從冷冷的冰箱扭蛋裡蹦出來，兩邊拉扯冰條，筆畫「啪」地彈回原位。
object: a fuzzy round gachapon pocket creature with a toy fridge
morph: two teams of icicle-shaped strokes are tugged apart by the creature and a frosty fridge door, then spring together into 冷
creativeAngle: 以冰箱門和小怪獸拔河，冷氣把小怪獸吹得抖成毛球。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale butter-yellow background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 冷 as the only text on screen, drawn in icy cobalt blue solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a mint-green gachapon capsule pops open and a round fuzzy lavender creature with big eyes bursts out and ricochets off the frame edges, landing in front of a small toy fridge as the first 冷 is spoken and the two stroke groups (the two-dot ice part on the left, the 令 part on the right) float in from opposite sides. 1.7-3.5s: the creature grabs the left ice-dot piece in its mouth while the fridge door swings open and sucks the right piece the other way, a comic tug-of-war with the creature's fur stretching like taffy, the second 冷 spoken as the pieces SPRING together into the glyph with a rubbery boing. 3.5-5s: a gust of cold air whooshes from the open fridge and blows the creature backward into a spinning fluff-ball with frosty shivering, the word 冷氣 spoken as a little cartoon blue air-conditioner-style breeze swirls out of the fridge (animated swirl only, no text). The creature then shakes off and gives a double-take at the glyph. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "冷、冷、冷氣" (ㄌㄥˇ、ㄌㄥˇ、ㄌㄥˇ ㄑㄧˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 冷 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
